matching_rule: Whitespace runs are collapsed to a single space before matching, because PDF text-layer extraction re-flows spacing. Token ORDER and exact tokens are still required, so a paraphrase or a lost word is a miss.
unit_numbering: 1-based unit ids for pages, sheets, slides and paragraphs, shared by Python, Rust, TS and citations.
status_meaning: coverage_complete=true is only allowed when every unit produced content. An empty or unread unit must appear in units_empty/units_failed/units_needing_ocr.
